business_process: Defense design engineering for Prime A
description: 3D models from legacy drawings; tooling and fixture design; tolerance analysis; drawing release packages (all CUI)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 70% of revenue (about $500 per working day); task orders have fixed design review dates; Prime A can reassign work after a missed review; CAD licenses are node-locked to the laptop, so a new laptop needs a license transfer (1 to 2 business days)
manual_workaround: Tell Prime A the same day and agree new dates; continue analysis by hand calculation; no other device or person may work on the CUI
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01 (SYS-10 after migration); SYS-04; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Prime A; CAD software vendor (license transfer); internet service provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure: the only engineer and the only person authorized to handle the CUI); home office

business_process: CUI exchange and design reviews with Prime A
description: Downloading and uploading drawings through the Prime A portal; email with Prime A engineers; monthly design reviews on site
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prime A sends new drawings and markups several times a week; a missed upload delays Prime A's own schedule
manual_workaround: Use the laptop over the phone hotspot; carry the encrypted laptop to Prime A for review; never use another computer for CUI
dependent_systems: SYS-06; SYS-02; SYS-01 (SYS-10 after migration); SYS-03 (MFA)
dependent_third_parties: Prime A (portal and engineers); internet service provider; mobile carrier

description: Fixture and machine-part design for commercial customers (proprietary data under NDA; some EAR-controlled technology)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 30% of revenue; deadlines are flexible by a few days
manual_workaround: Reschedule deliverables; work from the cloud copy on the laptop once restored

description: Invoices against Prime A task orders and commercial jobs; payments; records for Schedule C
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prime A pays 30 days after invoice, so a one-week delay costs little; FCI in task orders and invoices

business_process: Contract compliance and DoD incident reporting
description: SPRS score and CMMC affirmation; ability to report a cyber incident to DoD within 72 hours (DFARS 252.204-7012(c)); contract correspondence with Prime A
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DFARS 252.204-7012 requires a report within 72 hours of discovering a cyber incident, using a DoD-approved medium assurance certificate; a late or inaccurate SPRS score or affirmation can cost the follow-on award
manual_workaround: Report from any trusted device that holds the medium assurance certificate (not yet obtained); phone Prime A's subcontract administrator to say a report is coming
dependent_third_parties: DIBNet (DoD); SPRS; Prime A subcontract administrator; external certificate provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; also the Affirming Official)
